title: De Dana Dan
desc: Two penniless friends are in desperate need of money in order to marry their respective girlfriends. In their attempts to make quick money, they kidnap a rich woman's pet and demand a hefty ransom.

title: Khuda Gawah
desc: Baadshah Khan seeks revenge for Benazir's father's murder, navigating a tumultuous journey of love, sacrifice, and betrayal, ultimately leading to tragic consequences for all involved.

title: Golmaal Again
desc: Five orphan men return to the orphanage they grew up in to attend their mentor's funeral. However, they encounter the ghost of their childhood friend, Khushi, and help her attain salvation.

title: Bandhan
desc: Pooja, poor but loved, marries into wealth, faces infertility. Raju loves Jyoti; Thakur pursues Vaishali. Tragedy erupts as Raju is silenced and family betrayals shatter dreams.

title: Devdas
desc: When his family rejects his marrying his sweetheart, Devdas takes to alcohol, which ultimately leads to his emotional deterioration.

title: Dwarkadheesh
desc: Dwarka's sacred site, its deity Dwarkadhish, and the devotion of Krishna's people are brought to life, revealing legends of Krishna, Dwarka, and its temple.
